title: Mask Adoption Behavior and Policy Influence Simulation
description: Simulate how individuals adopt mask-wearing over time under social influence, information exposure, supply constraints, and policy interventions.

interactions.name: social_influence
interactions.description: Individuals adjust perceived norms and adoption likelihood based on neighbors' adoption in their social network and household.

interactions.name: policy_enforcement
interactions.description: Locations enforce mask mandates, influencing compliance through reminders, access control, or penalties.

interactions.name: information_dissemination
interactions.description: Government and media broadcast messages that update individuals’ risk perception, attitudes, and trust.

interactions.name: mask_procurement
interactions.description: Individuals purchase masks from retailers subject to stock and price, affecting access and subsequent adoption.

interactions.name: policy_feedback
interactions.description: Authorities adjust mandates and campaign intensity in response to observed adoption rates and compliance.

interactions.name: norm_feedback
interactions.description: Population-level adoption feeds back into perceived social norms that further influence individual adoption decisions.

metrics.name: mask_adoption_rate_over_time
metrics.description: Share of individuals wearing masks at each timestep.

metrics.name: final_adoption_rate
metrics.description: Share of individuals wearing masks at the end of the simulation horizon.

metrics.name: time_to_50_percent_adoption
metrics.description: Number of days until the population reaches 50% mask adoption.

metrics.name: peak_adoption_rate
metrics.description: Maximum adoption rate observed during the simulation.

metrics.name: adoption_disparity_index
metrics.description: Difference in adoption rates across groups (e.g., by SES, age, or political identity).

metrics.name: policy_effect_size
metrics.description: Difference in adoption rate attributable to mandate/campaign compared to a counterfactual without the policy.

metrics.name: average_enforcement_events_per_day
metrics.description: Mean number of enforcement interactions at locations per day.

metrics.name: masks_purchased_per_capita
metrics.description: Average number of masks procured per person over the simulation.

metrics.name: campaign_reach
metrics.description: Share of population exposed to at least one information campaign message.

metrics.name: post_policy_dropoff_rate
metrics.description: Rate of decline in adoption after a policy is lifted.

validation_criteria.name: adoption_convergence
validation_criteria.description: Adoption rate change is below 1 percentage point for 7 consecutive days by end of horizon.

validation_criteria.name: stock_nonnegativity
validation_criteria.description: Retailer stock levels never become negative at any timestep.

validation_criteria.name: bounded_probabilities
validation_criteria.description: All computed adoption probabilities remain within [0,1].
